decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, EX.01 and EL.01 received 3 June 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Reason: To provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities in accordance with policy;
(a)  ENV-B.1.1 New Development 
(b) S.4.2 Shop Front Design.
description: Installation of new timber framed shop front with sash windows and front door to right
